name: Survivor
description: Survivor (Hebrew: הישרדות‎, Hisardut), formerly known as Survivor 10, is an Israeli reality competition game show based on the popular international Survivor television franchise. The series began in December 2007 and aired on Israeli's Channel 10 for 6 seasons. After legal issues between Channel 10 and Castaway Television, the series went on a three-year hiatus before returning in 2015 on Reshet. The show is hosted by actor and singer Guy Zu-Aretz.

videos.title: The glamor world has entered the mud
videos.overview: 18 famous survivors reach the toughest game on television, but only one of them will win the last surviving title.

videos.title: The first impeachment of the season
videos.overview: The first Tribal Council of the season ends with a surprising ouster, Zohar and Israel's quarrel rises, and the first prize mission gets underway.

videos.title: Everyone is against Israel
videos.overview: The Capra clan begin to acclimate to the island and divide into camps, the two tribes receive new swimsuits to help them feel more at ease on the island and the season's first immunity mission begins in turmoil and at the end of the chapter the Capra clan comes to an ousted tribal council.

videos.title: Ilana returns to take revenge
videos.overview: Ilana thought she was ousted from the game but instead, she is getting revenge on Israel and big time, Adi Beatty reveals her full family story, and which of the tribes will win the prize office?

videos.title: The Beni Bruchim Show
videos.overview: The Beni Bruchim show gets underway with the Dirty King of Survivor. Will they catch the bad boy?

videos.title: Buzaglo goes on the attack
videos.overview: The Anting Anting Tribe fights for the first personal immunity chain in VIP survival, they arrive at a tribe council that is going to surprise everyone

videos.title: Who is the strongest leader on the island?
videos.overview: The negotiating cabin keeper receives a new lieutenant, the Anting Anting clan splits when David decides he is no longer silent to Asians not quarreling and the prize developer sets off between Buzaglo and Israel - who is the strongest leader on the island?

videos.title: one for all and all for one
videos.overview: Regev and Jordan each come to the other tribe to plunder an item, Israel breaks all the tools and decides to take revenge on his tribe, the mission of immunity is underway and the explosion between Benny and Ela is rising.

videos.title: Israel's trial begins
videos.overview: Ilana returns to a head-to-head duel for her voice at the upcoming Tribal Council and members of the Capra tribe discover that Israel has deliberately lost. How will the members of the tribe act after hearing that Israel has sold the mission?

videos.title: Israel's law - the decision
videos.overview: After Israel sells its immunity mission to take revenge on its tribe, the Capra Tribal Council is on its way - who will be rejected?

videos.title: The deal between Israel and Buzaglo
videos.overview: The prize mission gets underway with the tribal ranking from the more loving to the less loving, the negotiation cabin opens again and this time the decision of which of their tribal members will move to the second tribe until the end of the immunity mission and the leaders of both tribes meet for a secret summit committee and devour the cards of the game.

videos.title: The great boycott
videos.overview: Beni finds out what everyone really thinks of him and Israel gets a tempting offer. And what is the fateful decision the survivors have to make and may change the game?

videos.title: The big blast
videos.overview: What caused the big blast between Ido Kozikro and Lital Smadja in a season-changing episode? And what do Yarden and Idan think about the prospect of a relationship?
